en: Vintage multiview postcard featuring a central illustration of a large circular fountain in a busy urban square with carriages, pedestrians, and trees, labeled as 'Place des Consuls' in Alexandria. Two smaller inset images show a statue labeled 'STATUE DE BOIS CHEIK-…' and a scene with several men in traditional dress outside a building. Decorative grapevine motifs and handwritten script in Greek appear on the lower part. A green stamp with postmark is affixed in the upper right corner.
